entities.summary: Dimitris Anagnostopoulos is a Greek chess grandmaster. Anagnostopoulos grew up in England, where he was known as Demetrios Agnos, before switching federations to Greece in 1996. He played for "Kallithea Athens" (Greece) in the 7th European Chess Club Cup in 1990.
